title: Strong demand for crisis data checklists but few in place, UNESCO and CODATA survey finds
content:
Read the full article on the UNESCO Website.

Strong demand for crisis data checklists but few in place, UNESCO and CODATA survey finds

Most organisations working on disasters, crises and emergencies see value in a checklist for crisis data policies, yet few have one. This is the central finding of a global survey report published by UNESCO and the Committee (ISC) on Data of the International Science Council (CODATA) on 6 October 2026. The findings point to a next phase in which the Data Policies for Times of Crisis (DPTC) Checklist would be tested in practice with interested institutions.

title: FAIR Digital Objects Forum Upcoming Webinars
content:
The FAIR Digital Objects Forum is organising a series of webinars exploring various aspects of the endeavour to FDOs as a unified, technology-independent framework for representing and managing digital and physical resources in a machine-actionable manner. In the FDOF, FDOs are conceived as persistent bundles of information identified by globally unique and resolvable persistent identifiers (PIDs) that resolve to structured FDO Records defined by explicit profiles and registered attributes.

FDO Specifications 2026, 30 October 2026, 14:30 CET
Speakers: Sven Bingert, Jana Böhm, Maximilian Inckmann
Registration Link →
Announcement →
 

In 2025 the FDO Forum started developing a new, coherent, consolidated and integrated
FDO Specification document that

  • replaces the partly outdated and inconsistent set of documents that were written during
  • the first 5 years of work
  • integrates the various FDO implementations which have been developed in the
  • meantime
  • is much more formal allowing to develop FDO applications.
